research_branch.historical_anchor: J. Alinat & J.-Y. Cousteau (1962), Accidents de terrain en mer de Ligurie, CNRS, pp. 121-123

purpose: Calibrate the reverse acoustic pipeline before any underwater expedition. Preserve PASS, FAIL and AMBIGUOUS outcomes unchanged.
blind_rules: holdout labels are not exposed to the inverse classifier before scoring
absolute anchor frequencies 119 Hz and approximately 520 Hz are not classifier features
object scale L is not supplied to the first-stage classifier
first-stage features are scale-free frequency ratios, Q ratios, decay ratios, phase descriptors and multi-aspect normalized responses
all outcomes are persisted regardless of result
interpretation_rule: A synthetic PASS only validates software identifiability under the declared generator. It does not establish real-world identifiability. Any failed threshold remains a calibration blocker for expedition use until repaired and re-preregistered.
